why: Both analyses confirm the trained-and-coached early-reading hedgehog, refuse the grant as written, restore training and coaching, pause math and ReadAlong, and surface all three key brutal facts with appropriate restraint. Analysis 2 edges ahead by naming one-on-one tutoring and the denominator in the hedgehog sentence, treating funder-driven governance and measurement blindness as explicit decline mechanisms with thresholds, and being more calibrated (stated confidence, a site-mix alternative explanation, a test that would challenge its own hypothesis).
